theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_co_gradient_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid d → Euclid P) (V Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid d)) (F : ℕ → Euclid d → ℝ), LipschitzWith L f → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ j)) → (∀ j, InjOn (ψ j) (V j)) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ V j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F j)) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y j)) → (∀ j, IsCompact (closure (Y j))) → (∀ j, closure (Y j) ⊆ V j) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, f (ψ j y) = F j y) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) → μHE[d] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j) = 0 → ∃ (Y' : ℕ → Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), (∀ j, Y' j ⊆ Y j) ∧ (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y' j)) ∧ (∀ j, MeasurableSet (ψ j '' Y' j)) ∧ μHE[d] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y' j) = 0 ∧ Measurable G ∧ (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y' j, G (ψ j y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid d →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid d, inner ℝ (G (ψ j y)) (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y e) = fderiv ℝ (F j) y e
